svg.title: Ithilien & the Shadow
svg.desc: The Dead Marshes lie northwest of the Black Gate. Ithilien lies between Anduin and the Ephel Dúath; the Morgul road climbs east from Osgiliath. Original regional interpretation; north up; no numerical scale.

g.text: The Dead Marshes · the Morannon · the Morgul Vale
NORTH UP · REGIONAL SCALE · THIRD AGE
